## Preview

This site is under construction. Hosts, download URLs, and some contact
details are still placeholders.
:::

The WHOI CMIP data server holds CMIP6 model output and reanalysis products
(ERA5 first) on WHOI's VAST storage at `{{< var vast_prefix >}}`, organized in
the standard CMIP directory layout and indexed by an
[intake-esm](https://intake-esm.readthedocs.io/) catalog.

- **[Browse](browse.qmd)**: filter by model, experiment, variable, and more,
  then copy paths, URLs, or a Python snippet. See [Holdings](holdings.qmd) for
  everything on the server.
- **[Data access](access.qmd)**: on HPC, over the SMB share, by HTTPS
  download ([download guide](download-guide.qmd)), or from public cloud
  mirrors. Use the [catalog](catalog.qmd) from Python.
- **Learn**: start with the [quickstart notebook](notebooks/quickstart.ipynb),
  or take the [WHOI short course on climate model output](https://ashleylasinsky.github.io/whoi-climate-tutorial_2026/pages/intro.html).
- **[Help](report.qmd)**: report a problem, request data, or ask on Slack.
- **[Cite the server](cite.qmd)** in your publications.

News about the server, catalog releases, and maintenance windows is on the
[blog](blog/index.qmd).
